title: Eve of the Ceremony
next_chapter_hook: "Han Lie gave Chen Ji a provocative smile during the ceremony rehearsal. What murderous intent lay hidden in that smile?"

text.content:
"Night inked the world, and in the bamboo grove behind the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Chen Ji sat alone on a slab of blue stone. The note in his hand he had turned over no fewer than ten times—four characters: ‘Heavenly Eye’—yet it weighed like a thousand pounds, nearly crushing the breath from his lungs.

This was what Chen Nian had slipped him before leaving. The mingled resolve and worry in her eyes still lingered, unforgettable. Heavenly Eye… The name had appeared only once in the Tianji Record Fragment, mentioned in passing while recounting the ancient great catastrophe, a terrifying existence.

Chen Ji tucked the note into his sleeve, his gaze flickering in the darkness. How had his sister learned this name? What connection did Zhang Shen have with this legendary entity? Countless questions churned within him, yet his face remained as placid as still water."

dialogue.content:
"‘Heavenly Eye…’ An aged voice echoed in his mind—it was the residual soul guardian, Mo Xiansheng. ‘You finally found this name.’

Chen Ji’s heart tightened, yet he betrayed nothing. In his mind, he asked: ‘Master, do you know of this thing?’

Mo Xiansheng’s residual soul trembled faintly on the first page of the Tianji Record. After a long pause, he said: ‘I know something. But now is not the time to tell you. You only need to remember—the Heavenly Eye is everywhere, yet never acts personally. It prefers to use chess pieces, and after using them, discards them like refuse.’"

text.content:
"Chen Ji fell silent. The information in Mo Xiansheng’s words sent a chill crawling down his spine—omnipresent, yet never acts personally. Did that not mean anyone could be its chess piece? Including himself?

The thought filled him with deep unease. But he quickly suppressed this feeling, the corner of his mouth curving upward in a faint smile. Since the Heavenly Eye liked to use chess pieces, he would prepare to become one—until the day he overturned the entire board.

At that moment, a soft wind rustled beyond the bamboo grove. Chen Ji’s eyes sharpened; his hand quietly reached for the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve. The approaching presence was familiar—it was Ye Qing."

dialogue.content:
"A black shadow darted from the depths of the bamboo grove—it was Ye Qing. She had changed into a night combat outfit tonight, outlining her graceful curves, though her expression was grave.

‘Chen Ji, the Demonic Path forces have already infiltrated near the sect,’ Ye Qing lowered her voice, her expression solemn. ‘My scouts report the Holy Sect has sent at least three Elder-level figures this time. Their target is this ceremony.’

Chen Ji’s brow rose slightly, yet he showed little surprise. Though important, this news fell within his expectations. What truly caught his attention was what Ye Qing was about to say next."

text.content:
"Ye Qing, seeing his composed demeanor, couldn’t help but admire him secretly. Learning of the Demonic Path forces pressing upon them, he remained so calm—either he was deeply scheming, or he had long been prepared. She inclined toward the latter.

‘There is one more thing.’ Ye Qing moved closer, her voice dropping even lower. ‘My people discovered strange formations at Fifth Elder’s residence—the plaza around the ceremony grounds has been laid with a prohibition array, specifically targeting… Tianji aura.’

Chen Ji’s pupils constricted. Tianji aura? Prohibition array? His fingers unconsciously brushed the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve. Fifth Elder was targeting him!"

"Ye Qing seemed unaware of his reaction and continued: ‘That array was extremely covert. Had it not been for my… had it not been for someone under my command skilled in formations, it would never have been discovered. Fifth Elder has arranged an “accident” for you at the ceremony. This much is nearly certain.’

Chen Ji rose slowly. Moonlight filtered through the bamboo leaves, casting mottled shadows across his face. Fifth Elder, you truly are impatient.

He turned to Ye Qing: ‘Lady Ye, why are you telling me all this?’"

dialogue.content:
"Ye Qing fell silent for a moment. Complex light flickered in her beautiful eyes: ‘Because you are the only one who can help me break the Holy Sect’s chains.’

Her voice grew slightly hoarse: ‘Do you know what it feels like to be controlled? Every breath, every thought, monitored. I refuse to be a chess piece any longer.’

Chen Ji gazed at her quietly, as if peering into her soul. After a moment, he nodded: ‘Very well. Since we share a common enemy, may our cooperation be fruitful.’"

choice.prompt: "Fifth Elder’s trap is complete, the ceremony approaches, and Chen Ji must decide: to turn the tables or strike first?"

choices.text: "Turn the Tables, Lure the Snake from Its Den",
choices.description: Pretend ignorance, let Fifth Elder’s trap be exposed before all eyes, then strike back and pin him to the pillar of shame."
choices.visible_reward: "Completely expose Fifth Elder’s conspiracy, reputation soars"
choices.risk_hint: "Should the array’s power exceed expectations, severe injury is possible"

dialogue.content:
"A cold light flickered in Chen Ji’s eyes as his lips curved upward slightly: ‘Since Fifth Elder wishes me dead, I shall let him die knowing exactly why.’

He began calculating rapidly—Fifth Elder’s array must relate to the Tianji Record. He would use this as bait, completely exposing the other party’s fox tail."

choices.description: "Before the ceremony begins, take the initiative to strike, disrupting Fifth Elder’s deployment and catching him off guard. Greater risk, but also greater reward."
choices.visible_reward: "Completely seize the initiative, driving the enemy into a passive position"
choices.risk_hint: "If the enemy has contingencies, total defeat may follow"

dialogue.content:
"Ye Qing’s eyes flashed with surprise, then transformed into appreciation: ‘You are quite decisive. But the risk is greater—are you certain?’

Chen Ji replied coolly: ‘I dislike being passive. Rather than wait for the enemy’s move, I will force him to reveal his weaknesses first.’"

choices.text: "Borrow Strength to Counter, Bring in External Aid"
choices.description: "Use Ye Qing’s Demonic Path forces to create chaos, then link Fifth Elder’s conspiracy with the Demonic Path invasion, killing two birds with one stone via internal sect contradictions."
choices.visible_cost: "May become tainted with Demonic Path suspicions"
choices.visible_reward: "Leave Fifth Elder speechless while weakening rival factions within the sect"
choices.risk_hint: "If exposed for colluding with the Demonic Path, reputation will be ruined"
choices.process_label: 布置嫁祸五长老的证据

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji suddenly laughed—a smile carrying an indecipherable meaning: ‘Lady Ye, I have a proposal. Since the Demonic Path wishes to join the fun, why not let them lend a small hand?’

Ye Qing’s brow arched: ‘You want my people to cooperate in your play?’

‘Precisely. Connect Fifth Elder’s conspiracy with the Demonic Path invasion. At that point, even if he jumped into the Yellow River, he could never wash himself clean.’"

text.content:
"The decision made, Chen Ji began arrangements with urgency.

He had Ye Qing leave first, then slipped into the ceremony plaza under cover of night. As expected, Fifth Elder’s prohibition array had taken shape. Those formation runes faintly glinted with an eerie light under the moonlight—had he not sensed the Tianji Record Fragment’s aura, he would never have detected them.

Chen Ji crouched down, carefully studying those formation runes. The more he looked, the tighter his brow furrowed—this array not only targeted Tianji aura but resembled a lethal trap specifically designed to seal and slaughter prophets!"

dialogue.content:
"‘This array…’ Mo Xiansheng’s voice suddenly rang out, heavy with gravity. ‘This old one has never seen its like, yet its suppression of Tianji aura is extremely precise.’

Chen Ji’s heart stirred: ‘Master means?’

‘Fifth Elder has backers. That person’s understanding of the Tianji Record is perhaps no less than yours.’ Mo Xiansheng paused. ‘Be careful. At the ceremony, variables are many.’

Chen Ji silently memorized these words. Someone whose understanding of the Tianji Record rivaled his own—could that person be a chess piece of the Heavenly Eye?"

text.content:
"He did not disturb the array. Instead, he left several concealed markers around it, then slipped away.

Returning to his quarters, Chen Ji took out an ancient turtle shell—a treasure he had accidentally obtained at a ruin long ago, capable of briefly masking Tianji aura. He planned to use this to deceive Fifth Elder’s perception at the ceremony, then give the other party a ‘pleasant surprise.’

Outside the window, the east had begun to brighten. The ceremony was today."

"The Tianqing Sect’s ceremony was the sect’s grandest annual event.

At dawn, the entire sect was already bustling. Inner Disciples wore pristine white Taoist robes, while Outer Disciples dressed in blue garments, lining up in neat rows. A grand platform had been erected in the plaza, housing the sacred tablets of past Patriarchs. Incense smoke curled upward, creating an atmosphere solemn and majestic.

Chen Ji mingled among the Outer Disciples, eyes downcast, appearing harmless. But his divine sense continuously swept the surroundings, cataloging every detail of the plaza.

Fifth Elder stood to the left of the platform, conversing charitably with several Elders. Yet Chen Ji noticed—whenever a disciple passed that specific location, Fifth Elder’s eyes would flicker with an imperceptible gleam."

dialogue.content:
"‘Oh, isn’t this our trash of a Senior Brother?’

An arrogant voice came from behind. Chen Ji didn’t need to turn to know—it was Han Lie, the Xuanwu Sect’s foremost genius, and one of the people he least wished to see at this ceremony.

Han Lie walked to his side, looking down at him with a smirk: ‘I hear you’ve been quite prominent lately. Even Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao looks at you differently. Unfortunately,废物—waste—even if it bounces about, it’s still just a clown.’

The surrounding Outer Disciples cast strange glances. Some gleefully waited for drama, others felt sympathy, but no one dared speak."

choice.prompt: "Han Lie humiliated him publicly. How to respond?"

choices.description: "Now is not the time to reveal strength. Han Lie’s provocation is merely the tricks of a clown—not worth getting angry over."

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji slowly raised his head. His gaze was as still as dead water: ‘Senior Brother Han speaks truly. This junior brother truly is waste; being alive is enough.’

There was no anger in his tone, no frustration—only a chilling calm.

Han Lie paused, then burst into laughter: ‘At least you know your place!"

choices.text: "Hidden Needle in Soft Silk, Covert Counterattack"
choices.description: "表面上恭顺，实则用话语暗暗刺他，让他在得意忘形中露出破绽。Be outwardly deferent, but embed thorns in the words, causing him to reveal weaknesses in his triumph."
choices.visible_reward: "Make Han Lie eat a public loss without leaving any handle"
choices.risk_hint: "Han Lie may fly into a rage from humiliation"

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji微微躬身，语气恭敬：“韩师兄教训得是。不过师弟有一事不明——据说师兄在青龙秘境中被困了三天三夜，最后是靠什么脱困的呢？”

Han Lie脸色骤变。“你……！”他眼中闪过一丝杀意，却又强行压下，“你最好记住今天说的话！”"

text.content:
"Han Lie snorted coldly and turned to leave. But after a few steps, he suddenly looked back, offering Chen Ji a smile laden with meaning.

That smile carried undisguised murderous intent, as if to say: At today’s ceremony, you will see.

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, alarm bells ringing in his heart. Han Lie and Fifth Elder… could they already be in league?"

"The ceremony bells rang out, signaling the imminent start.

Sect Master Ling Yuan ascended the platform, surrounded by disciples. White-haired and white-bearded, with an otherworldly aura—the very image of an enlightened master. His gaze swept across the assembly, pausing briefly on Chen Ji—a fleeting moment where Chen Ji felt a tangible pressure bearing down, nearly stealing his breath.

This was a probe. Chen Ji immediately centered his mind, feigning fear. Ling Yuan’s lips curved faintly upward as he withdrew his gaze and began reciting the ceremonial address.

Chen Ji exhaled silently. This old fox Ling Yuan had indeed been watching him all along. Today’s matter would be more complex than imagined."

"At that moment, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji’s sleeve suddenly grew warm.

His heart tensed. He probed with his divine sense without betraying anything. The next instant, a blurred image materialized in his mind—on the ceremony platform, blood spattering, Fifth Elder pointing at Chen Ji and shrieking ‘Demonic Path spy!’, while surrounding disciples showed expressions of terror or fury…

The premonition succeeded! Though the image was blurry, Chen Ji had caught the critical information: Fifth Elder’s plan was to frame him as a Demonic Path spy!

A cold smile curved his lips. What a scheme Fifth Elder has indeed—but did you think this could sentence me to death?"

dialogue.content:
"‘What did you see?’ Mo Xiansheng’s voice resounded in his mind.

Chen Ji answered internally: ‘Fifth Elder intends to frame me as a Demonic Path spy.’

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment: ‘This aligns with your previous speculation. But one thing you should note—your Heavenly Fate just depleted 5 points; you now have only 75 points remaining.’

Chen Ji’s brow creased. Every use of the Tianji Record depleted his Heavenly Fate, and when the value reaches zero… he dared not imagine. Unless absolutely necessary, he could no longer use the Tianji Record’s premonition ability carelessly."

choice.prompt: "The ceremony is about to enter its most critical phase, and Fifth Elder’s plan is about to be activated. How should one respond?"

choices.text: "Watch and Wait, Let the Enemy Strike First"
choices.description: "Since we already know the enemy’s plan, why not turn the tables? Wait until Fifth Elder publicly accuses you, then expose his conspiracy and humiliate him before all."
choices.visible_cost: "Must endure the pressure of being publicly labeled a spy"
choices.risk_hint: "Should public opinion spiral out of control, may become impossible to挽回"
choices.process_label: 暗中联络苏青瑶作为证人

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji quietly glanced toward Su Qingyao. The latter seemed to sense something, slightly turning her head; their gazes met.

Chen Ji gave a subtle nod. Su Qingyao’s brow furrowed, yet she said nothing, only discreetly shifting position in the crowd—precisely where she could support him at a critical moment.

Good. Su Qingyao was indeed sharp."

choices.description: "Before Fifth Elder makes his move, create chaos first, breaking his rhythm and causing him to panic."
choices.visible_reward: "Completely seize control of the ceremony initiative"
choices.process_label: 触发夜清安排的魔道骚乱

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji’s fingers moved subtly. A wisp of spiritual energy shot from his fingertip, striking a prohibition node at the plaza’s edge.

The next instant, a thunderous boom erupted from the western side of the ceremony plaza, black smoke billowing upward!

‘Demonic Path attack!’ someone screamed in terror.

Chaos erupted. Fifth Elder’s expression shifted—his original plan had been completely disrupted by this sudden upheaval. For a moment, he didn’t know how to react."

text.content:
"Chen Ji stood in the crowd, gazing at the chaotic scene before him. A faint smile played at the corner of his lips.

No matter how many schemes and plots Fifth Elder harbored, they were worthless before absolute strength. And Chen Ji, he was precisely the sort who excelled at overcoming the strong with the weak, at winning through wit.

The ceremony bells still echoed, but the platform ritual could no longer continue. Ling Yuan’s face dark, he commanded the平息骚乱. Fifth Elder stood to one side, glowering, his gaze constantly searching through the crowd.

Chen Ji knew—once the chaos subsided, the true contest would just begin."
